# World Airports Database

> Global airports database with ICAO/IATA codes, coordinates, city, country, elevation, and timezone. 7,900+ airports.

This repository contains a database of world airports database covering 1 datasets with 7,914 records.

## Available Formats

- SQLite database (.db) — ready to query
- SQL dump (.sql) — import into MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, etc.
- Excel, CSV, PDF — available at https://listbase.org

## Data Structure

Table: `airports`
- `icao` (TEXT)
- `iata` (TEXT)
- `name` (TEXT NOT NULL)
- `city` (TEXT)
- `state` (TEXT)
- `country` (TEXT NOT NULL)
- `elevation` (INTEGER)
- `lat` (REAL)
- `lon` (REAL)
- `tz` (TEXT)

## Download

- GitHub Releases: https://github.com/listbase-org/world-airports-databases/releases
- Excel/CSV/PDF: https://listbase.org/en/transport/
